from: September book, night 24 (He Will Wipe Away Tears)
p1: Isaiah told about a happy day that will come. On that day, no one will need to be sad anymore.
Isaiah said, “The Lord will wipe away tears from off all faces.” Every tear, on every sad face!
Think of a mom gently wiping a crying child’s cheek. Isaiah used that picture so we would know how kind the Lord is.
p2: People will say, “We have waited for Him, and He will save us.” They will be so glad! The Lord they waited for is Jesus.
Jesus sees your tears too. When you are sad, He helps you. Tonight, gently wipe a teddy’s cheek, the kind way Jesus cares for you.
old: Isaiah shared a message so tender and kind that it feels like a warm hug from Heavenly Father.
“Someday,” Isaiah said, “Heavenly Father will wipe away the tears from every face. There will be no more crying, and everyone will be happy!”
Imagine Heavenly Father gently drying your tears with the softest, most loving touch, whispering, “It’s okay now, My child. Everything is going to be all right.”
Heavenly Father sees every tear we cry. He cares about every sad feeling, and He loves to comfort us and turn our sadness into joy.
Even when we feel sad today, we can remember Heavenly Father’s promise: He wipes away tears, and He fills our hearts with comfort and love.
